case_149.label_scope: One fixed implementation label across the full public domain, with exact final FP16 rounding.
case_149.analysis: Every finite FP16 encoding is compared with an independently certified binary16 rounding result in multiple orders/offsets. Lengths, masked tails, signed zeros, subnormals, input/backing preservation and output freshness are tested separately; scalar exhaustion does not cover every tensor execution.

oracle.scope: Directed mathematical intervals supply the oracle; mpmath agreement is an independent numerical cross-check. Exhaustive scalar encodings are separate from tensor indexing and GPU specialization checks.
oracle.method: MPFR 320-bit directed exp(-x), addition and reciprocal. Lower sigmoid bound uses an upward denominator; upper bound uses a downward denominator. Exact integer-ratio RNE rounding of both endpoints must select the identical binary16 encoding.
oracle.independent_crosscheck: 110-digit mpmath uses (1+tanh(x/2))/2, algebraically different from the oracle and candidate stable exp/division paths.
oracle.tail_argument: For x<=-32, 0<sigmoid(x)<exp(-32); for x>=32, 1-exp(-32)<sigmoid(x)<1. The directed bounds both round to +0 or 1 respectively; no input is removed from the domain.

integer_rounder_audit.method: Python Fraction exact dyadics, parity-based tie expectation, and quarter-interval points independently validate integer rounding.

indexing.argument: For index=program_id*BLOCK+lane, adjacent blocks cover disjoint adjacent intervals. mask index<N retains [0,N) exactly once. The full legal N range has 1..BLOCK active lanes in its last block, with int32-safe address indices.
indexing.scope: Arithmetic model of the audited source indexing, not exhaustive GPU testing of every N, address, or compiler specialization.

public_reference_conversion.reason: Explicit half packing avoids a platform-specific Torch float64-to-half path that may pass through FP32. Whole sigmoid references are also checked against the independent oracle above.
